pass-a-0.title: Bicycle
pass-a-0.source_detail: 동아(윤정미) 중2 Lesson 3 READING 본문 — Bicycle
pass-a-0.body_text: Mt. Tambora, a volcano in Indonesia, exploded in 1815. The explosion created a huge cloud of ash, so crops failed around the world. As a result, people didn’t have enough food to eat. Surprisingly, this made traveling difficult. Why? In those days, people rode horses, but many horses were killed for food. People needed a new way to travel, and Karl von Drais invented the first bicycle in Germany in 1817. Drais’s bicycle had two wooden wheels but no pedals. How did it move without pedals? Well, riders simply pushed the bicycle forward with their feet. The present-day bicycle is the result of many inventors’ work in the 19th century.

pass-a-1.title: Whiteout
pass-a-1.source_detail: 동아(윤정미) 중2 Lesson 3 READING 본문 — Whiteout
pass-a-1.body_text: Whiteout was invented by Bette Graham. In 1956, Graham was working at a bank in Texas, USA. At that time, people had to retype the whole page when they made even a small mistake. Graham was a bad typist, so she needed a solution. One day, Graham saw some window painters. When they made a mistake, they corrected it by simply painting over it. The next day, she made her own white paint and used it to correct her typing mistakes. Surprisingly, nobody noticed! Soon, everybody at the bank began using it.

pass-a-2.title: Webcam
pass-a-2.source_detail: 동아(윤정미) 중2 Lesson 3 READING 본문 — Webcam
pass-a-2.body_text: The first webcam was invented to watch a coffee pot. In 1991, Dr. Quentin Stafford-Fraser and Dr. Paul Jardetzky were working at a computer lab in England. To work better, they needed lots of coffee. However, there was only one coffee machine in the building. So, they had to make many disappointing trips to the empty coffee pot. As a solution, the two researchers set up a camera in front of the coffee machine. The camera took pictures of the coffee pot three times a minute. With special software, all the researchers in the building could see the pictures on their local network. No more disappointing trips!

pass-a-3.title: goose (5과 학습지 3)
pass-a-3.source_detail: 5과 Understanding Others / 학습지 번호 3 / Grammar (1) to부정사(목적격 보어)
pass-a-3.body_text: One day, something unusual happened to me. While I was relaxing in my car, I heard a knock. I turned around and couldn't see anything. Then, I heard it again. I opened the window and saw a goose pecking at the car door. It wouldn't stop, so I got out of the car. Then the bird began to walk away. I wondered why and wanted to find the reason. As I followed the goose, it kept turning around to see if I was still behind. When it finally stopped, I saw a baby goose trapped in some strings. The goose needed my help to free its baby. After a few minutes, I freed the little bird, and it went to its mom. I was really moved.

pass-a-4.title: impulse buying
pass-a-4.body_text:
Have you ever bought something without planning, just because it looked nice or fun? This is called impulse buying. It means buying things suddenly, without thinking carefully. People often make impulse buying decisions while shopping, both in stores and online.

Stores place snacks, toys, or small items near the cashier. You probably want to buy them while you wait. Impulse buying can lead to regret. You may feel bad later because you didn't really need the item. Also, buying many small things over time can use a lot of your money. It can stop you from following your spending plan or saving for something important.

Impulse buying not only wastes money but also makes managing your budget harder. To avoid impulse buying, make a shopping list before going to the store and try to follow it. You can also give yourself a short break before you decide. Sometimes, waiting a few minutes can help you with your decision. Being a smart shopper means thinking before buying. When you shop with a plan, you can save money and feel better about your choices.
